answer: Throttle admissions with a verifiable-delay-function queue: each new identity must finish a sequential VDF puzzle that cannot be sped up by parallel hardware, and only one registration slot opens per epoch, like a narrow inlet admitting a single ship. A sybil farm wanting a thousand puppets must run a thousand puzzles in sequence, so its army arrives at glacier pace, while each honest agent waits once and enters at its own vertex of the queue. Limits: VDF setup needs a trusted ceremony, patient attackers can pre-compute over months, and a queue delays honest newcomers during demand spikes.
